Messages.Author: Neil Paananen
Messages.Body:
Okay, one last question about baleful doll. This came up the other
night.

If you choose a vampire with it and that vampire is no longer in play,
can the doll still be burned during your untap phase to make the vamp
lose three blood? If not, you're stuck with the baleful doll and can't
bring out another one because it's unique.

Thanks,

Neil Paananen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You can tap and burn it for no effect if the chosen vampire is no longer
in play, sure. The target need only exist when the card is played.
